newsitem.title: FINLAND: TAMFELT SEES BETTER FULL-YEAR 97 EARNINGS.
newsitem.headline: TAMFELT SEES BETTER FULL-YEAR 97 EARNINGS.

text.p: Finnish paper manufacturing equipment supplier Tamfelt Oy Ab said on Thursday it expected full-year 1997 earnings to improve on 1996.

"Since Tamfelt's main client group, the forest industry, expects a positive trend for the remainder of the year, Tamfelt estimates sales volumes to grow and the full-year result to improve although the key focus of the earnings trend is at the start of the year," Tamfelt said in a statement with its first tertial earnings report.
In 1996, Tamfelt's pre-tax profit was 98 million markka, operating profit 83 million markka (15.6 percent of net sales), and earnings per share 11.20 markka.
